hints.title: Digit Replacement Mapping
hints.text: Convert each integer into its mapped representation by substituting every digit with mapping[digit].

hints.title: Maintain Initial Order for Ties
hints.text: When two numbers produce equal mapped values, retain their relative original input order.

hints.title: Sort via Custom Key
hints.text: Sort nums using the mapped value as primary sorting key while employing a stable sort.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N log N * D) where D is number of digits (D <= 9)
complexity.space: O(N) mapped keys and output array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unstable sorting algorithms scramble relative order on tie breaks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-mapping values enables fast sorting with minimal overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly handle the zero digit edge case and stable sorting.

solutions.approach: Python stable sorted with digit mapping key.
C++ tuple sorting with positional index tiebreaker.
Java index sort with precomputed mapped values.
JavaScript array map and sort with index tiebreaker.
